event_name: Cornwell Quality Tools NHRA U.S. Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 81 degrees, relative humidity 49 percent, barometer 30.05 inches,
adjusted altitude 2,877 feet. 

Langdon is 5 - 3 against Stewart in prior events and this is the first time they have faced each
other in a final round.

Langdon with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  Langdon wins his fourth Indy
Wally, third in Top Fuel.  This is Langdon's fifth win this season and 27th in his career.

Stewart dropped a cylinder on the top end.
